  - It projects with an un-normalised (ux, 0.9·uy) dot product.
  - It then scales by 0.9 again (`cy` = 0.81·py).

| 90° | W HIT | W HIT | W miss | W miss | W miss |
| 30° | | | | | not warned, HIT |

- **Fix:**
